people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
translations.bsb: “They do not need to go away,” Jesus replied. “You give them something to eat.”
translations.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat
